<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Agenda convivio Plastioriente · 18 de diciembre</title>
<style>
:root{--g:#91C789;--y:#FECC6B;--p:#EC5C7F;--b:#87B2DF;--bg:#14213a;--bg2:#1c2f52;--tx:#fff;--mu:#c8d3e8;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;font-family:"Trebuchet MS",Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,var(--bg2),var(--bg) 70%) fixed;background-color:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);overflow-x:hidden}
#snow{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
#intro{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;background:var(--bg);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:24px;transition:opacity .9s,visibility .9s}
#intro.off{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
#intro img{width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;padding:8px;animation:bob 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
#intro h2{font-size:1.5rem;margin:18px 0 6px}
#go{margin-top:18px;border:0;border-radius:40px;padding:15px 34px;font-size:1.1rem;font-weight:700;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--p),var(--y));color:#1b1b2b;cursor:pointer;animation:pulse 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{transform:scale(1.07);box-shadow:0 0 28px var(--p)}}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(-12px) rotate(3deg)}}
main{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 18px 90px}
.hero{text-align:center;padding:48px 0 24px}
.hero img{width:130px;height:130px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;padding:6px;animation:bob 3s ease-in-out infinite}
.hero .k{letter-spacing:.35em;color:var(--y);font-size:.8rem;margin-top:16px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(2rem,8vw,3.4rem);margin:6px 0;line-height:1.05;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--g),var(--y),var(--p),var(--b));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent;background-size:300% 100%;animation:flow 8s linear infinite}
@keyframes flow{to{background-position:300% 0}}
.hero p{color:var(--mu);margin:4px 0}
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin-top:16px}
.chips span{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18);border-radius:30px;padding:8px 16px;font-size:.95rem}
#count{display:flex;gap:10px;justify-content:center;margin:26px 0 8px}
#count div{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:14px;padding:10px 12px;min-width:68px;text-align:center}
#count b{display:block;font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--y)}#count small{color:var(--mu);font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase}
h3.sec{text-align:center;margin:40px 0 18px;font-size:1.4rem;color:var(--y)}
.tl{position:relative;padding-left:26px}
.tl:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;border-radius:3px;background:linear-gradient(var(--g),var(--y),var(--p),var(--b))}
.it{position:relative;margin:0 0 16px;padding:14px 16px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-left:6px solid var(--c);opacity:0;transform:translateX(-40px);transition:all .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1)}
.it.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
.it:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-31px;top:20px;width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--c);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--bg),0 0 14px var(--c)}
.it .h{font-weight:800;color:var(--c);font-size:1.05rem}
.it .t{font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;margin-top:2px}
.it .r{margin-top:8px;color:var(--mu);font-size:.92rem;line-height:1.45}
.it.game{background:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.req{display:grid;gap:12px}
.req div{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:all .7s}
.req div.show{opacity:1;transform:none}
.req i{font-style:normal;font-size:1.8rem}
.end{text-align:center;margin-top:44px;font-size:1.6rem;font-weight:800}
.end small{display:block;color:var(--mu);font-weight:400;font-size:.85rem;margin-top:6px}
#mus{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));z-index:20;width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:50%;border:0;font-size:1.4rem;background:var(--p);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
#mus.on{animation:spin 3s linear infinite}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style></head><body>
<canvas id="snow"></canvas>
<div id="intro"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo Plastioriente Perico"><h2>🎄 Agenda del convivio 🎄</h2><div style="color:var(--mu)">Plastioriente · 18 de diciembre</div><button id="go">Ver agenda 🎁</button></div>
<button id="mus" aria-label="Música" title="Música">🎵</button>
<audio id="au" loop preload="auto" src="data:audio/mpeg;base64,"></audio>
<main>
<section class="hero"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo Plastioriente Perico"><div class="k">PLASTIORIENTE · PERICO</div><h1>Agenda del convivio</h1><p>Viernes 18 de diciembre de 2026</p>
<div class="chips"><span>📍 Jardín El Cerro, Fraijanes</span><span>🚌 Salida 15:00 de la bodega</span><span>🎉 Hasta las 12:00 am</span></div>
<div id="count"></div></section>
<h3 class="sec">✨ Agenda de la noche ✨</h3>
<div class="tl" id="tl"></div>
<h3 class="sec">🧥 No olvides</h3>
<div class="req">
<div><i>🧥</i><span>Llevar suéter: en Fraijanes hace mucho frío.</span></div>
<div><i>🚗</i><span>No traer carro a la oficina. El regreso a casa va por nuestra cuenta (Uber/InDriver).</span></div>
<div><i>⏰</i><span>Estar puntual en la bodega antes de las 15:00.</span></div>
<div><i>🥳</i><span>¡Disfrutar!</span></div></div>
<div class="end">¡A disfrutar!<small>Plastioriente Guatemala · Perico</small></div>
</main>
<script>
var G="#91C789",Y="#FECC6B",P="#EC5C7F",B="#87B2DF";
var A=[["15:00","Salida de la bodega a Jardín El Cerro","",G],["16:00 – 17:00","Llegada estimada a Jardín El Cerro","",Y],["18:00","Inicio de nuestro convivio de fin de año","",P],["18:30","Palabras de bienvenida para los colaboradores","",B],
["18:40","🎈 Juego 1: Ponerse el suéter sin dejar que el globo caiga","Dos personas participan. Deben ponerse el suéter sin dejar que el globo caiga al suelo. El ganador se lleva un premio; el perdedor toma un shot.",G,1],
["18:55","🍺 Juego 2: Beer pong","Dos equipos de 4 participantes. Gana quien logre meter más tapitas/pelotas en los vasos con agua; cada integrante del equipo perdedor toma un shot.",Y,1],
["19:10","🎤 Juego 3: Karaoke","4 personas cantan una canción de forma individual y el público escoge al ganador: quien reciba más aplausos y gritos recibe un premio.",P,1],
["19:30","🎟️ Inicio de la rifa","",B],["20:00","🍽️ Cena","",G],["21:00 – 00:00","🪩 ¡A disfrutar!","",Y]];
var tl=document.getElementById("tl");
A.forEach(function(a){var d=document.createElement("div");d.className="it"+(a[4]?" game":"");d.style.setProperty("--c",a[3]);
d.innerHTML='<div class="h">'+a[0]+'</div><div class="t">'+a[1]+'</div>'+(a[2]?'<div class="r"><b>Reglas:</b> '+a[2]+'</div>':'');tl.appendChild(d)});
var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(e){e.forEach(function(x){if(x.isIntersecting){x.target.classList.add("show");io.unobserve(x.target)}})},{threshold:.15});
document.querySelectorAll(".it,.req div").forEach(function(e){io.observe(e)});
// cuenta regresiva (hora de Guatemala, UTC-6)
var T=Date.UTC(2026,11,18,21,0,0);
function tick(){var s=Math.max(0,Math.floor((T-Date.now())/1000)),v=[[Math.floor(s/86400),"días"],[Math.floor(s%86400/3600),"horas"],[Math.floor(s%3600/60),"min"],[s%60,"seg"]];
document.getElementById("count").innerHTML=v.map(function(x){return"<div><b>"+x[0]+"</b><small>"+x[1]+"</small></div>"}).join("")}
tick();setInterval(tick,1000);
// música
var au=document.getElementById("au"),mus=document.getElementById("mus");
function sync(){mus.classList.toggle("on",!au.paused);mus.textContent=au.paused?"🔇":"🎵"}
function play(){try{var p=au.play();if(p&&p.catch)p.catch(function(){})}catch(e){}sync()}
document.getElementById("go").onclick=function(){document.getElementById("intro").classList.add("off");au.volume=.8;play();burst()};
mus.onclick=function(){au.paused?play():au.pause();sync()};au.onplay=au.onpause=sync;sync();
// nieve + confeti
var cv=document.getElementById("snow"),cx=cv.getContext("2d"),W,H,F=[],C=[];
function rs(){W=cv.width=innerWidth;H=cv.height=innerHeight}rs();addEventListener("resize",rs);
for(var i=0;i<70;i++)F.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:1+Math.random()*3,v:.4+Math.random()*1.1,o:Math.random()*6});
function burst(){var cols=[G,Y,P,B];for(var i=0;i<110;i++)C.push({x:W/2,y:H/2,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*14,vy:-Math.random()*13-2,c:cols[i%4],s:4+Math.random()*5,l:120})}
function draw(){cx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);cx.fillStyle="rgba(255,255,255,.85)";
F.forEach(function(f){f.y+=f.v;f.o+=.02;f.x+=Math.sin(f.o)*.5;if(f.y>H){f.y=-5;f.x=Math.random()*W}cx.beginPath();cx.arc(f.x,f.y,f.r,0,7);cx.fill()});
C=C.filter(function(c){c.x+=c.vx;c.y+=c.vy;c.vy+=.35;c.l--;cx.fillStyle=c.c;cx.fillRect(c.x,c.y,c.s,c.s);return c.l>0});requestAnimationFrame(draw)}
draw();
</script></body></html>
